items.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: A five day a week radio show with Bob Crosby, call the Club 15.

ctx.x: At the end of that time I did a radio show. Television hadn’t started then. A five day a week radio show with Bob Crosby, call the Club 15. It was a short program but it was five days a week. And that went for five and a half years. In the meantime you do recording too, with different groups. And somewhere along the line I bought an orchard, in San Diego county, which I kept that orchard until I broke my back.
What did you grow there? Oranges?
